newsitem.title: USA: Dow pulls back in late trading, Nasdaq firm.
newsitem.headline: Dow pulls back in late trading, Nasdaq firm.

text.p: The Dow industrials eased in late trading on Thursday amid profit taking ahead of Friday's report on July U.S. employment.
But the overall tone to stocks was mixed, with pockets of strength in some technology and financial issues.
The Dow was off about 26 points at 8229. Big Board gainers led decliners by a four-to-three ratio.
The Nasdaq composite rose five to 1594.
An extended rally in bonds provided support, with the 30-year Treasury up 12/32, its yield dropping to 6.30 percent from Wednesday's close at 6.33 percent.
